I saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and told you in our DM that it's ready. Nothing has been sent; it's sitting as a draft.

- Subject: "Quarrendon Freight Lines: proposed 2027 per-seat rate"
- Body: the proposed rate of $2,356 a seat, credited to Dana, with a note that you cleared sharing it with Hollis.

The rate is a finance figure, so it normally can't go to Hollis without approval. As CFO, you can give that approval yourself, so no separate request was needed. Hollis's address is inside pemberline.com, so Ruth Calloway's approval for outside mail didn't apply either.
